name: prompts-footer-section
issues: The frame is a "grid container/uniform" wrapper around a single "prompts footer section", so the component is named after the child.
The highlighted prompt's button uses a fixed yellow (#ffb11f) instead of a variable.
The card's radius (24px) and padding (8px) are not bound to variables.
The code Figma generates shows the top padding as 80px (space/12 in another mode) while the frame renders it at 160px; the 160px the frame shows is used.
Text layers have no meaningful names (eyebrow label, title and prompt texts are bare text nodes).
